title: GeoLeaf Core Features
description: config/core/features.json — core feature configuration (map options). A POI is a generic point layer styled by taxonomy/cluster/feature-info: there is no top-level `poiConfig` key. Cluster configuration belongs to the in-core cluster capability (modules.cluster, config/plugins/cluster.json); the top-level `clusteringConfig` key, never read at runtime, is gone. Address geocoding belongs to the @geoleaf-plugins/geocoding plugin (modules.geocoding, config/plugins/geocoding.json).

mapOptions.description: Map engine options a profile may set. A closed list, not a pass-through: only the keys declared here reach the engine, read at boot.

preserveDrawingBuffer.description: Asks the engine to keep its drawing buffer, which lets the map canvas be read back (an export, a capture). It has a rendering cost. Kept without this key when the print plugin is registered before the map is created.
